input: i think it makes sense to vamp up the semantic structure and structured tagging of the prompt and documentation system within the repo.
task: Owner asked to strengthen the semantic structure and structured tagging of the prompt and documentation system.

errors.what: First doc_index.py assigned GENERIC twice; check_duplicate_symbols caught it in the local workflow run

doc_friction.issue: 'Duplicate PRs' names search_pull_requests, which this cloud session does not have; the system prompt says to use `gh api search/issues`, which returned no output and no error, so a duplicate search could not be confirmed either way.

`run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes` is recommended without saying it outlasts the 120 s tool timeout (it ran ~40 workflows here); the first foreground call was killed. Also ran einvoice-preflight-ci.yml, whose paths this diff does not touch.

The map says which file answers a question but not which section, so 'where are shallow clones covered' needed grepping CLAUDE.md's 'Duplicate PRs' section; docs/taxonomy.json now adds section anchors.

deviations.why: Control-plane wiring (prompts-ci step, promptctl validate hook, SYSTEM.md/CLAUDE.md pointers) kept out of this PR so it is not held for owner approval
deviations.did: Shipped the vocabulary, report front matter and tool in unowned paths; the wiring follows in a separate small PR from the same branch after this merges

deviations.why: The control-plane PR waits for owner approval per CODEOWNERS, so it cannot be merged in-session
deviations.did: Opened it and left it for the owner

goal: Make the guidance and agent notes queryable by topic and project
notes: Local checks: `python3 -m unittest test_doc_index` 9 OK; `doc_index.py check` ok; `check_post_frontmatter.py` exit 0; `check_duplicate_symbols.py` clean after fix. `run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes`: the einvoice-preflight failures (ModuleNotFoundError einvoice_preflight, one node test 'every other country page links to the Hungary page') reproduce with this branch's changes stashed, so they are not from this diff. Backfill: 261 reports, 132 with a subject, 72 with a topic, 164 dated, 97 left undated rather than guessed. Posts: 2,050, 919 distinct tags, 476 used once, 808 posts carry at least one tag that resolves to a topic. Follow-up control-plane PR (same branch, restarted from main after #12909 merged): `promptctl validate` runs `doc_index.py check`; prompts CI runs test_doc_index and triggers on docs/reports/** and docs/taxonomy.json; SYSTEM.md and CLAUDE.md point at `doc_index.py find`. Two reports reached main without front matter while #12909 was open (2026-11-03-routine-measures, polish-2026-11-03-baseline-audit), so missing front matter is a warning by default and only `--strict` fails on it.
